figurative_meaning_en: Everything appears uniform or indistinguishable everywhere
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্যার কারণে সমস্ত এলাকা জলে একাকার হয়ে গেছে।
আকাশে মেঘ জমে সবকিছু একাকার দেখাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to the flood, the entire area has become all one watery expanse.
The sky is overcast with clouds, making everything look uniform and monotonous.
note: Often used in contexts of flooding, reflecting Bengal's geographical vulnerability to monsoons.
